title: Cocycle Leray edge agrees with the Grothendieck edge
statement: For schemes X,Y [def-pc-scheme], f:X→Y, and a cocycle Leray edge ε [lem-pc-leray-edge-cocycle-data] on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], put D=f_* and G=Γ(Y,−), with module cohomology defined by [pqf-def-cohomology]. For every acyclicity witness hFG [def-sp-composite-acyclicity], there are natural isomorphisms e_q from H^q(X,−), after forgetting scalars, to R^q(D⋙G), after forgetting scalars. Each ε_q is e_q followed by the underlying additive Grothendieck left edge [lem-sp-grothendieck-edge-maps]. No vanishing assumption is made.

source.place: Lemma 01F4 (2), construction of the Leray edge

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-leray-sections-resolution-comparison to f to obtain the natural isomorphisms e and their cycle formula. Establish left exactness of direct image by the Mathlib pullback-pushforward adjunction, and of sections by evaluation. Specialize grothendieck_left_edge_cocycle to D and G and the supplied hFG to obtain c and its quotient equation.

For a coefficient F use its chosen injective resolution. The inverse resolution isomorphism and homologypi are epic in modules and hence surjective, so every input class is represented by a global cycle s. Use LerayEdgeCocycle and the resolution comparison to get z-prime and z. Their inclusion equations agree, and G(iCycles) is monic, so z-prime=z. Postcompose the generic quotient equation with G of the inverse resolution isomorphism to cancel the final G of its hom. Evaluate this equality at z. The comparison formula identifies the input on the Grothendieck side; the Leray cocycle formula identifies the output on the Leray side. The two values coincide on every class. ConcreteCategory.hom_ext gives the component equality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01F2 and 01F4 (2); resolution comparison isolated, remaining edge equality proved by surjectivity and uniqueness of lifts (G1)

Leray spectral sequence edge is isomorphism if cohomology of higher direct images vanishes
mathlib_searches.results: Connecting-map isomorphism results for group cohomology and homological complexes; no Leray specialization
No Mathlib hits. Source has grothendieckLeftEdgeMap and project has grothendieck_left_edge_cocycle, but neither identifies LerayEdgeCocycle.

lean.statement: theorem leray_edge_grothendieck_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (ε : LerayEdge X Y f) (hε : LerayEdgeCocycle f ε) : letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) let G := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Y.toRingedSpace letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G := inferInstanceAs (PreservesFiniteLimits (SheafOfModules.evaluation (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace) (op ⊤))) let D := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom ∀ hFG : D.IsAcyclicComposablePair G, ∃ e : ∀ q : ℕ, (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q ⋙ forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat) ≅ ((D ⋙ G).rightDerived q ⋙ forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat), ∀ (q : ℕ) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)), (ε q).app F = (e q).hom.app F ≫ (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat).map ((D.grothendieckLeftEdgeMap G hFG q).app F)
